text:
emma_cs: Quick ping on CopperWave onboarding. Their renewal is in 6 weeks and product team sees 95p spikes ~2.2s and token burn ~1.7x forecast. Thinking a tight pilot: int8 canary + small-model hop for short prompts + routing fallback. Thoughts?

ryan_se: +1. They prefer snappy UX over tiny fidelity gains. Recommend 3% canary to int8 for /summarize and a tiny small-model for <200 tokens.

priya_ml: Ran eval on 80 customer prompts. redwood-int8-r2 kept semantic parity median 0.987. Edge failures on multi-step instructions. Suggest semantic gate and a 48h A/B.

josh_sre: Infra: tenant on shared us-central. KV caching could shave tails. Dedicated low-latency route helps but costs +12%. Hybrid route seems best.

carla_pm: We should package this as a one-pager for renewal: projected token savings 22% and 95p latency down ~18%. Add a 1-question pulse after pilot about perceived speed.

ryan_se: Canary plan: 3% traffic to int8 for /summarize-short, long inputs (>800 tokens) -> fp16, fallback to fp16 on semantic_cosine < 0.98 or latency > 1800ms. 48h monitoring.

# routing snippet (ryan_se):
```
route: "copperwave-summarize"
policy:
  - condition: tokens(input) < 200 and rand() < 0.03
    target: redwood-small-1
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 200 and rand() < 0.03
    target: redwood-int8-r2
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 800
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
fallback:
  - on_semantic_cosine_lt: 0.98
    action: route_to redwood-fp16-stable
  - on_latency_gt: 1800ms
    action: route_to redwood-dedicated-lowlatency
```

priya_ml: I'll prepare a short eval notebook and an automated comparator for the seed prompts. Thresholds: semantic >=0.98, 95p_latency < 1.8s, token_cost_reduction >=20%.

josh_sre: ops notes: will provision canary nodes, enable KV cache toggle, add alerts: semantic < 0.98 (20m) and 95p > 1800ms (15m). tagging ops-bot.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-copperwave-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.98 (20m), 95p_latency > 1800ms (15m). owner: josh_sre.

emma_cs: I'll send a short pilot invite to the customer and schedule a 30m enablement session. Thanks all. :rocket:
